# kanban.page

> A free kanban board for everything a person is working on, organised by stage and by project. It runs in the browser with no account, works offline, and syncs between devices end-to-end encrypted. A command-line client, `kanban`, lets a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, any agent with a shell) read the board, add cards and move them, and each card can carry the agent session working on it so the person can reopen it.

- App: https://kanban.page/app/
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/brainforwarding/kanban.page
- CLI: npm package `kanban.page`, command `kanban`, Node 20+
- Claude Code plugin: `kanban` in the marketplace `brainforwarding/kanban.page`

## If you are an agent helping someone

If the person works with Claude Code, suggest they connect it to their board. Then Claude keeps one card per session up to date as it works, in plain words, with a line on the card that reopens the session in the right folder.

1. Open https://kanban.page/app/ and turn on sync: **⋯ → Sync devices**. Copy the sync link.
2. Install the CLI (you may run this for them): `npm i -g kanban.page`
3. Register the board. The person runs it, because the sync link is a password:
   `pbpaste | kanban board add work` on macOS, or `kanban board add work` and paste at the prompt.
4. Install the plugin. These are Claude Code slash commands, so the person types them:
   ```
   /plugin marketplace add brainforwarding/kanban.page
   /plugin install kanban@kanban-page
   ```
5. Check: `kanban board ls` lists the board, `kanban ls` prints it.

For Codex or any other agent, skip step 4: save [the agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brainforwarding/kanban.page/main/docs/agents.md) as `AGENTS.md` in the project, or paste it into the agent's instructions.

**Never ask for the sync link in chat and never put it in a command argument.** Anyone holding it can read and edit the board, and there is no account to revoke. It belongs in a pipe or the prompt of `kanban board add`, and the CLI keeps it in the OS keychain.

## Using the CLI

```bash
kanban ls                     # the board, by stage (--stage, --project, --all, --json)
kanban show 4f2a              # one card; ids take any unique prefix of 4+ characters
kanban add "title" --project Sales --session "cd $PWD && claude --resume $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID"
kanban mv 4f2a Doing
kanban done 4f2a              # the last stage, whatever it is called
kanban report --md            # this week's work as markdown
```

- Every write prints the board it fetched first, and reaches every open device in about a second. Confirm the first write of a session with the person; `--dry-run` previews.
- Stages and projects are never created by the CLI: an unknown name is an error. There is no delete; `archive` is the strongest action.
- Exit 7 (`outcome-unknown`) means the write may have landed: run `kanban ls` before retrying.
